item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.30)] Blackstone Sees Earnings Boom Fueling AI, Infrastructure and Fundraising Growth
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.30)
Blackstone is experiencing an earnings boom, driven by strong fundraising and investments in AI and infrastructure. The company reported over $260 billion in inflows in the past year and significant growth in infrastructure assets, with a focus on data centers, power, and frontier AI. CFO Michael Chae expects double-digit base management-fee growth by 2027, bolstered by new funds, perpetual-capital vehicles, and a favorable exit environment.

item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] AI progress and responsibility: Nvidia, Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs weigh in at Salesforce’s annual event
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
Salesforce's annual Dreamforce conference hosted CEOs from Nvidia, Anthropic, and OpenAI, highlighting Salesforce's deepened commitment to AI and strategic partnerships. The event saw the launch of new AI products, including Koa (a reasoning model built with Nvidia) and AIforce (an interface layer extending its relationship with Anthropic's Claude). A significant portion of the discussion revolved around the critical need for responsible AI development, with leaders like OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei expressing calls for caution and improved practices.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.24)] Does Managed AI Connectivity Change The Bull Case For Equinix (EQIX)?
item.description:

While this strategy could boost high-margin interconnection services, it also carries execution risks related to open specifications, customer adoption, and competitive pricing pressures.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Align Technology (ALGN) Following Invisalign Expansion, Fair Value Still Sits Higher
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.32)] Lenovo vs. HP: Which PC Giant Stock Has Better Prospects?
item.description:

(HPQ), focusing on their strategies in the burgeoning AI PC market, infrastructure solutions, and printing businesses. While Lenovo is diversifying into higher-margin AI infrastructure and services, HP is leveraging its strong PC performance and recurring print revenues. The analysis includes financial estimates, price performance, and valuation metrics for both companies, concluding that HP may have an edge due to its capital returns prioritization and cash flow stability.

item.title: [NVDA Bearish (-0.31)] Cadence Tensilica IP Powers Analog Devices’ Next-Generation DSP Architecture
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bearish (-0.31)
Cadence's Tensilica DSP architecture is being integrated into Analog Devices' (ADI) next-generation SHARC automotive audio processors, aiming to significantly boost performance for advanced in-vehicle audio solutions. This collaboration provides a 5X performance improvement over previous ADSP processors, enabling enhanced audio experiences, voice interactions, and AI capabilities in future automotive platforms. The new SHARC-FX core, part of ADI's ADSP-SC84x/2184x platform, is optimized for on-chip AI/ML and signal processing workloads, supporting applications like music genre identification and real-time vocal removal.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.15)] Salesforce Slips as Dreamforce Puts Its $3.9 Billion AI Engine on Trial
item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.34), NVDA Bullish (+0.44), AMZN Bullish (+0.34)] Cisco Delivers Trusted AI at Scale Through New Splunk Advancements
item.category: MSFT Bullish (+0.34), NVDA Bullish (+0.44), AMZN Bullish (+0.34)
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.34), NVDA Bullish (+0.44), AMZN Bullish (+0.34)
Cisco is enhancing its Splunk offerings with new AI advancements to enable trusted AI at scale, particularly for on-premises customers, through an expanded partnership with NVIDIA. The innovations include the Cisco AI POD for Splunk, real-time AI spending and agent usage tracking with Splunk Agent Observability's Tokenomics solution, and security advancements for an agentic security operations center (SOC). Additionally, Splunk and AWS are collaborating on co-developing security solutions to combat AI-driven attacks.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.32), AMZN Bullish (+0.28)] Splunk rebuilds its platform around agents
item.description:

The strategy focuses on observing and controlling AI systems, defending organizations at machine speed, and converting distributed machine data into actionable insights for both humans and AI agents. This involves a fundamental rethink of Splunk's data platform, including the introduction of Cisco Data Fabric to analyze data where it resides and partnerships with Nvidia and AWS for AI processing and security.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.25)] Robinhood and Webull Fall 4% as Imminent Clarity Act Decision Stokes Crypto Uncertainty
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.25)
Robinhood and Webull stocks dropped 4% due to uncertainty surrounding an imminent Senate vote on the CLARITY Act, a bill designed to create a clearer regulatory framework for digital assets. The procedural vote, which requires 60 votes, has put pressure on crypto-exposed brokerages and assets like Bitcoin, which also fell 3%. Investors are advised to keep positions moderate due to the elevated uncertainty, despite the potential upside for platforms like Robinhood if clear crypto regulation is established.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.31)] Alphabet Has 50% Upside and the Cheapest Multiple of the Big Six
item.description:

The article argues that Alphabet's valuation is mispriced compared to peers like Microsoft and Meta, given its faster revenue growth. Despite significant CapEx and temporary negative free cash flow, the bull case suggests substantial returns, while even the bear case projects a positive return.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.15), AMZN Neutral (+0.13)] BCE data-centre expansion could reshape long-term growth, Desjardins says
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.15), AMZN Neutral (+0.13)
BCE Inc. plans to significantly expand its Saskatchewan data-centre capacity to 1.2 gigawatts, a move that Desjardins Capital Markets believes could add substantial long-term value to the company. Desjardins maintained its Buy rating and C$41 price target, estimating the expansion could eventually contribute C$9 per share in value and materially alter BCE's growth profile. The project, which requires over C$5 billion in investment, is contingent on customer commitments and regulatory approvals, but is seen as a shift towards higher-growth infrastructure for Canada's largest telecom operator.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] Delos Data, a chip startup founded by Intel veterans, raises $100 million for AI networks
item.description:

Their technology aims to accelerate data movement within AI data centers, addressing the growing complexity and diverse hardware used in these facilities. The company's goal is to ensure efficient communication between various computing chips in AI data centers, preventing idle hardware and wasted energy.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.24), NVDA Bullish (+0.43)] Announcing Koa: Salesforce’s First CRM Reasoning Model, Built on NVIDIA Nemotron
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.24), NVDA Bullish (+0.43)
Salesforce and NVIDIA have announced Koa, Salesforce’s first CRM reasoning model for Agentforce, built on NVIDIA Nemotron. Koa is designed to help agents navigate complex, multi-step workflows by leveraging 27 years of Salesforce CRM intelligence, trained on synthetic enterprise knowledge. This collaboration also extends NVIDIA's open models and accelerated computing to Missionforce, offering enhanced control over AI models, data, and deployment for government and regulated organizations.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.32), AMZN Bullish (+0.34)] Salesforce Unveils AIforce, Bringing the Full Power of Its Platform to Any Interface
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.32), AMZN Bullish (+0.34)
Salesforce has introduced AIforce, a new live interface layer that extends the full capabilities of its CRM platform to any AI interface where users and agents work. This innovation allows companies to leverage their existing Salesforce data, workflows, and business logic within tools like Claude, Slack, and Lightning, enhancing productivity and enabling new ways for employees and AI agents to interact with business information. AIforce aims to democratize UI creation, allowing users to compose customized, intelligent interfaces on the fly, grounded in secure and governed Salesforce data.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] StoneX reiterates Qualcomm stock Buy rating on data center growth
item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31), AMZN Bullish (+0.32)] Salesforce deepens its integrations with AWS and Google Cloud to support AI agents
item.description:

These partnerships, announced at Dreamforce 2026, focus on bringing CRM data and AI agents into public cloud environments, offering broader model choices, and improving workflow integration. Key initiatives include making Salesforce business context available in AWS's Amazon Q, integrating AWS frontier agents into Slack, and enabling Gemini Enterprise to leverage Salesforce CRM data.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.29)] GE HealthCare Announces CareIntellect for Operations, Helping Health Systems Optimize Resources and Expand Access to Care
item.description:

This solution leverages proprietary AI models and two decades of hospital operations expertise to provide actionable guidance for optimizing resources and expanding patient access. The Queen's Health Systems and Duke Health are the first to implement the application, aiming to shift from reactive to proactive operational management.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.26)] Dyna Software Brings Enhanced Compliance Governance to ServiceNow Teams with Source Control Management (SCM)

This new capability allows for code review, inline commenting, and controlled deployments, addressing the growing need for audit readiness, especially with the increase in AI-generated code. The GuardRails platform aims to improve traceability, reduce deployment errors, and support organizations in regulated industries in maintaining compliance.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (-0.06)] Addressing the Risks of AI Knowledge Distillation
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (-0.06)
Knowledge distillation, a technique to compress AI models, offers efficiency but introduces governance challenges such as protecting proprietary models and ensuring security of distilled models. Organizations must differentiate between legitimate distillation and unauthorized extraction, and implement robust AI security controls and governance frameworks. The article outlines risks like unauthorized model extraction, propagation of harmful biases, guardrail bypassing, and data pollution, and emphasizes the need for comprehensive AI governance including security controls, provenance, architectural controls, and compliance.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.21), AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) Sets $60 Billion Ceiling With Qualcomm (NASDAQ: QCOM) As Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) Cuts Modem Ties

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.03)] Why Taiwan’s Silicon Shield Is Failing
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.03)
Taiwan's "silicon shield," stemming from its dominance in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, is facing challenges as China invests heavily in chip self-reliance, particularly in mature-node chips. While Taiwan still holds leverage in cutting-edge chips, China's increasing capacity in 28-nanometer chips threatens to make Taiwan's shield irrelevant for its own economy, potentially leading to a more fragile global trade environment with rising chip prices. This shift means that the geopolitical importance of Taiwan's chip production will no longer solely rely on the most advanced technologies, but also on the control of common chip manufacturing.

This manufacturing strategy is similar to Nvidia's, with TSMC also producing chips for other major tech companies like Apple and Tesla.
